objective: Construct and prove a deterministic no-effect shadow activation, migration, cutover, and rollback candidate for the exact admitted epoch-002 event-sourced ontology product, then present one final owner gate without changing live runtime state.
invariants: The admitted epoch-002 manifest and admission decision remain immutable inputs.
Canonical append-only events are the sole replay source for every ontology state.
Every node, relation, context binding, and challenge contract is calculated by folding its canonical events.
Latest snapshots and projections are disposable, noncanonical accelerators and never grant authority.
The exact Governance to Ontology Lifecycle v2 Context Map direction and bindings survive shadow migration.
Challenge contracts remain first-class records with their owner route and resolution boundary intact.
Shadow activation and migration use copied fixtures and disposable local state only.
The live admitted runtime, admitted product, and all protected bytes remain unchanged.
Every migration source, target, preimage, event cut, and calculated projection is digest-bound.
Rollback restores every tracked state and byte digest before evidence may pass.
Partial migration, stale admission, context drift, relation reversal, snapshot-source escalation, rollback corruption, and authority escalation must be detected.
Aggregate Goals drift unrelated to the selected admitted-product dependency set is diagnostic and cannot stop shadow product work.
No credential, live service, production data, publication target, or external system is used during candidate construction.
The sole owner gate occurs only after the cutover candidate and all deterministic test evidence are frozen.

stages.objective: Bind the exact inactive admission and prove every predecessor digest is current.
done_when: Admission validation is PASS, the implementation is admitted, and activation, migration, and cutover remain false.

stages.objective: Freeze the activation, migration, cutover, rollback, live-boundary, and exact target-inventory contract.
done_when: The contract identifies all shadow inputs, live protected state, migration preimages, comparison rules, rollback rules, and forbidden effects.

stages.objective: Build a deterministic shadow activation and migration harness over copied event streams and disposable state.
done_when: The harness has no live target or credentials and can replay both old and new projections from one exact event cut.

stages.objective: Run two shadow activations and prove deterministic calculated-state, context, challenge-contract, and compatibility results.
done_when: Both runs are byte-identical, declared compatibility checks pass, and every hostile mutation is detected.

stages.objective: Rehearse the full cutover sequence and exact rollback entirely in disposable state.
done_when: The disposable target reaches the expected event-calculated state, rollback restores all preimages, and no protected or external state changes.

stages.objective: Freeze one exact activation/cutover decision candidate and its independent admissibility evidence.
done_when: All candidate hashes are current, the evidence set passes, and no effect is performed or inferred.

stages.objective: Resolve the single final activation/cutover posture for one immutable tested candidate.
outputs: owner decision or explicit defer/reject/amend outcome
done_when: One option is selected against one immutable candidate digest; the selected effect is executed only by a separately bounded successor envelope.

shadow_scope.source_of_truth: canonical append-only event streams at one exact event cut
shadow_scope.calculated_state: latest node, relation, context-binding, and challenge-contract state produced only by deterministic event folds
allowed_effects: write and remove temporary local shadow state
forbidden_effects: activate the runtime or Context Map

required_checks: admission validation PASS and implementation admitted inactive
canonical event identity, order, and event cut stable
node and relation latest-state folds deterministic
exact Context Map direction and binding preserved
old and new calculated projections compared at the same event cut
cutover sequence deterministic in disposable state
live runtime and admitted product unchanged
validation_contract.pass_rule: All checks and hostile mutations pass in both deterministic runs with exact rollback, zero protected-byte drift, and zero external effects.
validation_contract.failure_rule: Freeze failed evidence, mark dependent stages not_evaluable, and do not open the final gate.

options.meaning: Authorize a separately bounded activation, migration, and cutover execution envelope for the exact tested candidate.
Authorize a separately bounded activation-only envelope; migration and cutover remain unauthorized.
Defer without changing runtime, data, or authority state.
Reject or require amendment and a new complete shadow evidence set.

operational_tasks.detail: Repair unrelated aggregate source-digest, Craft, inherited-contract, and ontology-view drift. None intersects the selected admitted-product dependency set, so it cannot stop shadow activation work.
Integrate existing D65 bytes later with an exact allowlist; no broad staging or unrelated-byte mutation is part of this plan.
A later effectful execution envelope must bind the exact live target, credentials, maintenance boundary, preimages, and abort conditions. Candidate construction uses none of them.
The final gate becomes evaluable only after AC-S5 freezes complete shadow activation, migration, cutover, rollback, and adversarial evidence.

registration.reason: CA2-ROUTE-PLAN produces a no-effect candidate and aggregate Goals validation is not a grant of execution authority.

claim_ceiling: A validated planning candidate for deterministic no-effect shadow activation, migration, cutover, rollback, and a later exact owner decision. It does not execute the product lane, activate a runtime or Context Map, migrate data, cut over, use credentials, publish, release, deploy, perform destructive action, or create external effects.
